source: I Am Sober app, '30 days without alcohol' guide
band: members who drank 21 to 70 drinks a week (drinking days times drinks per drinking day) and are quitting or cutting back
counted: heavy drinkers quitting or cutting back, not checked for addiction
measure: Share of that day's check-ins rated Hard or Impossible on the app's five-step scale (Easy, Not bad, Questionable, Hard, Impossible). The share is of all check-ins that day; the five ratings cover 96% of them on day 0 and 82% on day 30.
caveat: Only members who wrote a check-in that day are counted: 3,274 check-ins on day 1 and 735 on day 30, from a group of 112,675. The app does not say why the count falls; members who drank and restarted their count, or stopped using the app, leave the later days, so later days describe the ones still going.

check.notes: all 31 days matched the app's data; wording corrected as the checker gave it

quote: This guide is based on real check-ins from more than 280,000 I Am Sober members who are quitting or cutting back on drinking.
